summary: Your fifth Sunday review. You answer 8 questions on tokens, the context window, cost, attention and chunks with a confidence number, recompute the four numbers behind your checkpoint note, group your confusions into 3 themes, tag week 5 and plan week 6.
goal: Explain tokens, the context window and attention in your own words, defend four numbers, and plan week 6.

items.text: Self-test: answer the 8 questions with a 1 to 3 confidence number, then mark each one
Four sums: write or recompute your four numbers and check your note against them
Error log: group this week's confusions into 3 themes and fix the top one with a 5-minute experiment
Catch up: tick every unfinished step of Day 29 to Day 35, in order
Run git tag week-5 and see tag: week-5 in git log --oneline --decorate
Plan week 6: write one outcome sentence, put 7 sessions in your calendar, and write your drop list
Play the Week 5 Mix-up game to the end and see your score
